svg.text: 「When all tokens hit the cache, we must recompute the last token to obtain

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, SimHei, Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, sans-serif

svg.text: logits. Thus, set max_cache_hit_length to prompt_length - 1. This can

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, SimHei, Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, sans-serif

svg.text: trigger recomputation of an entire block … because allocate_slots()

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, SimHei, Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, sans-serif

svg.text: requires num_computed_tokens to be block-size aligned.」
